Insurance & Retirement Solutions-Decommissioning of SOAP-Based XML Services

Notice: a9835

Summary:

Decommissioning of SOAP-Based XML IFT Web Service Messages

Direct Registration System (DRS) Transformation - DRS Centralized Billing

Notice: 25130-26

Summary:

DTC is expanding DRS Centralized Billing to include DRS Profile Deposits, DRS Deliver Orders, and DRS Withdrawal-by-Transfer transactions as part of the DRS transformation program. Beginning November 13, 2026 (pending regulatory approval), FAST transfer agents will be required to use SPA for centralized fee billing, replacing manual invoicing to participants, and must establish their DRS fees in SPA by November 5, 2026.

DRS Withdrawal by Transfer Transaction Processing & DRS Centralized Billing and Legacy Withdrawal by Transfer Scope

Notice: 25131-26

Summary:

Effective November 13, 2026 (pending regulatory approval), DRS Profile Deposits, DRS Withdrawal-by-Transfer, and DRS Centralized Billing will move to SPA, with centralized billing becoming mandatory for applicable DRS transactions. Participants will need to route transactions based on the DRS Eligible Indicator, while certain legacy Withdrawal-by-Transfer activity, including certificated withdrawals and foreign ownership-restricted securities, will continue to be processed through PBS and existing CCF files.

DRS Withdrawal by Transfer Transaction Processing & DRS Centralized Billing and Legacy Withdrawal by Transfer Scope

Notice: 25133-26

Summary:

This notice advises FAST transfer agents that DRS Withdrawal-by-Transfer processing and DRS Centralized Billing will transition to SPA on November 13, 2026 (pending regulatory approval), with centralized billing becoming mandatory for DRS Profile Deposits and Withdrawal-by-Transfer transactions. While DRS-eligible transactions will move to SPA, legacy certificated withdrawals and certain foreign ownership-restricted securities will continue to flow through PBS and existing transfer agent files such as RSATFX and CF2DMX.
